Settings

Lock aspect ratio

Keep manual window resizing constrained to the current image proportions.

Click-through overlay

Let viewer windows stay visible without catching pointer input when you are working underneath them.

Slideshow interval

Used when a viewer window has more than one image.

Window opacity

This adjusts the real viewer window transparency, not just the app chrome.

100%

Native blur

Uses the host compositor when available. Support can vary by platform and window stack.

Blur uses native window effects when the current platform supports them.
